lan_warning: ⚠️ For use in a secured LAN behind a firewall only – never expose directly to the internet!
dash_reauth_desc: Your refresh token is no longer valid. One click on the button below will reconnect Daily Drive — no credentials need to be re-entered.
dash_playlist_empty: The playlist is currently empty or has not been loaded yet.
dash_playlist_error: Could not fetch playlist from Spotify:
quota_banner_title: Spotify rate limit reached (429 Too Many Requests)
quota_banner_reason: Spotify has detected too many requests. No action needed — the next update will run automatically once the cooldown expires.
setup_intro: I'll guide you through setting up Daily Drive step by step.
setup_step1_title: Step 1: Create a Spotify Developer App
setup_step1_desc: To allow Daily Drive to manage your playlists, you need to create a free Spotify Developer App.
setup_step1_hint4: Enter exactly this value as the Redirect URI:
setup_step1_redirect_hint: Copy this value exactly into your Spotify Dashboard → Redirect URIs. Use 127.0.0.1, not localhost — Spotify blocks localhost since Nov 2025.
setup_step1_hint5: Check both Web API and Web Playback SDK.
setup_step1_hint6: Open Settings → User Management and add your Spotify email address.
eacces_help_title: 📁 Fix permissions issue on Synology NAS:
eacces_help_step4: Ensure that Everyone has Read & Write permissions (check "Apply to this folder, sub-folders and files").
setup_nas_warning_desc: Spotify requires HTTPS for LAN IP redirect URIs. Since you are accessing via HTTP IP, you must use the loopback address in Spotify.
setup_step1_hint_nas_loopback: Use this loopback address in your Spotify Developer Dashboard instead of your NAS IP.
setup_step2_desc: Now we'll connect Daily Drive to your Spotify account. You'll be briefly redirected to Spotify and automatically returned.
setup_nas_mode_desc: Since your NAS is accessed via HTTP, we will authorize using a loopback IP. Follow these steps:
setup_nas_step1: Ensure that the loopback redirect URI is registered in Spotify.
setup_nas_step2: Click the authorize button below. You will be redirected to Spotify.
setup_nas_step3: After agreeing, your browser will land on a failed/blank page (e.g. Site can't be reached).
setup_nas_step4: Copy the entire failed URL from your browser's address bar.
setup_nas_step5: Return here and paste it below to complete the connection!
setup_step3_playlist_hint: Paste the Spotify share link or just the ID. Daily Drive can also create a new playlist for you.
setup_step3_podcasts_hint: Open a podcast show in Spotify, share the link — the ID is the part after /show/.
setup_success_desc: Daily Drive is now connected to your Spotify account. You can close the setup wizard.
config_setup_welcome_desc: Add your podcasts and tweak the music settings below, then hit Save.
config_podcast_pin_hint: The selected podcast will always appear at the start of the playlist, regardless of the mix pattern.
config_podcast_alternate_hint: When enabled, episodes from all podcasts are interleaved alternately instead of one podcast at a time.
config_total_songs_hint: Target number of songs in the playlist. If genres are specified, 50% comes from familiar sources (playlists / likes / top tracks) and 50% from genre discovery search.
config_genres_hint: Separate genres with commas or semicolons (e.g. pop, dance, indie). Note: Spotify returns up to 10 discovery tracks per genre search.
about_desc: Daily Drive recreates Spotify's discontinued "Daily Drive" feature — a playlist that automatically mixes your favourite podcast episodes with personalised music tracks, refreshed on a schedule.
about_powered_desc: This web UI was built with IBM Bob, IBM's AI coding assistant. Bob helped design, implement and iteratively refine this project.
about_based_desc3: This fork adds a full Docker-based web UI, IBM Bob branding, an OAuth wizard and scheduled playlist refresh.
reauth_intro: Your Spotify token is no longer valid. Follow these steps to reconnect Daily Drive.
reauth_nas_desc: Since your NAS is accessed via HTTP, you need to manually copy and paste the authorization URL.
